objective: Bind declared word semantics, exact decoding, current-cell initialization and source error/trajectory contracts in one manifest-bound independent consumer. Distinguish synchronous recurring readmission from stale sampling.
positive: Reproduce native decimal outputs against exact integer spec and source-bound Lean interfaces; at least one accepted multi-step true-state trace with persistent source identity.
mutations: rounded internal state as true state
acceptance: All20 rejected for the correct semantic reason; valid ties accepted under halfcell contract. Independent repeat from frozen inputs. Count formal proof, exact experiments and physical validation separately.
stop_rule: Renew only for new evidence or materially different test after every GO receives its first block; no hardware or public integration.
